data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'hafoc', which means 'hawk'. This name has been used throughout history to represent strength, power, and agility. In Christian tradition, the hawk symbolizes freedom, courage, and the ability to soar above challenges. The name Hawk carries the meaning “Strong, Powerful Hunter” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hawk usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, powerful hunter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
